usable_roof_fraction.note: Share of footprint usable for PV (chimneys, shading, access).

pv_kwp_per_m2_panel.note: Modern c-Si module, ~20% efficiency at STC.

pv_tilt_azimuth.note: Applied to every city (no local roof geometry).

net_to_gross_floor.note: Net heated area as share of gross floor area from OSM levels.

net_area_per_flat_m2.note: Average net area per dwelling, identical for all cities.

persons_per_flat.note: Average household size, identical for all cities.

default_levels_untagged.value: mean of tagged buildings in the block

heat_demand_reference_kwh_m2_yr.note: IWU TABULA Gruenderzeit multi-family house, unrenovated (~170-190); verify on TABULA WebTool. Applied to Berlin.

heat_demand_scaling.value: by heating degree-hours (base 15 C) relative to Berlin
heat_demand_scaling.note: No city-specific building stock data: other cities are scaled from the Berlin reference. Treat as order of magnitude.

heat_demand_deep_retrofit_kwh_m2_yr.note: Berlin value after deep retrofit; scaled like the reference.

heat_pump_cop.note: Seasonal COP held constant (real winter COP is lower, so winter coverage is optimistic).

household_electricity_kwh_flat_yr.note: Appliances and lighting, flat over the year, identical for all cities.

cooling.note: Summer cooling load (Austin, Madrid, Tokyo) is excluded.

tank_m3_per_home.note: Distributed storage sizing; tank is simulated day by day against ERA5 rain.

bounding_streets: Calle de Luis Vélez de Guevara
